newsitem.title: USA: Essex seeks hearing on listing status.
newsitem.headline: Essex seeks hearing on listing status.

text.p: Essex Corp said it had a hearing with the National Association of Securities Dealers to seek continued listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market even though the company did not maintain capital and surplus of at least $1 million.
The hearing was scheduled to take place on June 12, it said.
Under a 30-day exception, the company's common stock would continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.

Essex said that no assurance can be given that it can regain compliance with maintenance requirements. In the event it is unsuccessful at the hearing, the company said it anticipates that its securities will be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market as early as June 12.
The company said it was considering alternatives for the trading of its common stock, which may include qualifying for trading on the OTC Bulletin Board Service.
Essex is a producer of optoelectronic processor products and provides specialized technical products and services to government and industry.
